name: Steal a Pet
desc:
Buy Pets, earn cash, and defend your collection from thieves!
But you can also be that thieve... 👀

[How To Play]
• Buy a Pet who appears from the portal!
• Earn cash from the Pets!
• Steal Pets from other players!
• Become the player with the most worth!

💡 Your pet continues to make money even offline! So, come back every day!
🎁 Like the game and Join the Group for a FREE Legendary Pet!


💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
